verdict.rationale: Postmark documents raw bounce management, message tracking, delivery/open/click stats, webhooks, and DMARC monitoring as an add-on, which cover bounce/complaint/engagement counts and some reputation-adjacent tooling (DKIM/SPF/Return-Path verification, DMARC). However, there's no evidence of interpretive guidance, inbox-placement scoring, or sender-reputation recommendations beyond raw metrics and configuration options. Missing for 10: dedicated inbox-placement analytics/scoring, proactive reputation guidance or alerts, and any interpretive dashboard beyond raw stats/DMARC reports.
